The Authentic Name

Scholarly reference for Léshy

Scholarly Transliteration

Léshy

No indigenous writing system is securely attested for individual slavic names. The form shown is a modern scholarly transliteration.

ASCII Constraint

LESHY

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

Léshy

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
léshy.com → xn--lshy-bpa.com

The non-ASCII characters in Léshy are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is Léshy. PUNYCODEX does not claim this domain is available; always verify status with a registrar.

Tier Classification

Why Léshy is classified as Tier-2 Accent-Preserving

The Slavic original Léshy contains only stress (acute accent). This makes it a single-tier Tier-2 name. The Unicode restoration preserves what can be preserved — honoring the single feature that distinguishes it from plain ASCII.

Stress
Preserved
Acute or circumflex accent marks the pitch stress of the original.
Length
—
Not present in this restoration.
Dual Variant
—
Only one valid Unicode restoration exists for this name.
